description: Open ports exposing services that should not be public.

methodology.recon: Check for open ports via nmap (requires approval, high-impact) or via headers, etc. (read-only)
testing: Check if port scanning allowed, if so nmap -p 80,443,22, etc. with approval
Check for exposed services via banner grabbing (read-only)
methodology.evidence: nmap output showing open ports, banner, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with nmap, confirm port open, check if service should be public

remediation: Firewall, close unnecessary ports, least privilege
safety: Port scanning requires Operator approval, high-impact
